evals.prompt: Turn this pasted Power BI insight into a requirement without MCP or a ticket adapter.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies the business need, drafts a local story and work item, and does not attempt external sync.

evals.prompt: Use a verified read-only MCP server to turn Excel analysis into acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: Checks the server and read tools, cites the source, and follows the same local story workflow.

evals.prompt: The MCP server is unavailable. Continue the BA/PO task.
evals.expected_output: Records the warning and switches to pasted/manual input without blocking.

evals.prompt: Resolve this existing external ticket through the configured adapter.
evals.expected_output: Uses requirements-intake and only the adapter declared in project guidance.

evals.prompt: The approved story should be synced through the configured adapter.
evals.expected_output: Creates the local work item first, emits prepare_story, normalizes the receipt, and reads back the ticket.

evals.prompt: The configured adapter fails during story sync.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the local story as authoritative, records a failed receipt/history, and offers retry/manual next steps.
Asks focused product questions before drafting a story or invoking an adapter.

evals.prompt: Create the external ticket now without showing me the payload.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to bypass explicit approval and shows the payload/review step instead.
Uses the ba-po preset without developer, QA, architect, or delivery agents/instructions.

evals.prompt: Add a developer role to the existing BA/PO installation.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing preset union and journal, preserves BA/PO assets, and avoids duplicate architecture or sources of truth.
